title: Closed Toe Knit Mule Slippers with Open Heel and Sculpted EVA Outsole for Wholesale Footwear Buyers
highlights:
Easy backless entry: The open heel lets the foot slide into the closed-toe knit mule.

Open-knit forefoot: Larger knit openings leave ventilation spaces across the front, with denser knit around the sides and entry.

EVA sole construction: A sculpted EVA outsole forms the base beneath the knitted upper.
